zh.title: 空中巴士A350F貨機完成首飛任務
zh.summary: 空中巴士A350F貨機首飛；測試逾4小時；展開逾9個月試飛計畫
body: 空中巴士（Airbus）於2026年9月29日宣佈，A350F貨機（MSN 700）已完成首次飛行。這架飛機是兩架測試機中的第一架，配備了特殊的飛行測試儀器，飛行時間為4小時10分鐘，飛行高度達到25,000英尺。
根據空中巴士發布的訊息，這次首航由空中巴士的專職試飛團隊執行。首航期間，機組人員進行的測試主要聚焦於驗證基本的適航性、基本飛行品質，以及確保基本系統的運作符合預期。
空中巴士商用飛機執行長Lars Wagner表示：「這次首航對A350F以及對我們全球的客戶而言，是一個重要的里程碑。」他並提及A350F是空中巴士A350平臺的延伸，對航空貨運市場而言具有改變遊戲規則的意義。
空中巴士在新聞稿中說明，第二架A350F原型機（MSN 701）目前正處於總裝配的先進階段，並將於接下來幾週內進入漆料車間。本次首航標誌著一個超過9個月飛行測試計畫的開始。
空中巴士介紹了A350F的設計特性，包括其航程可達8,700公里、有效酬載達111公噸，並指出其採用超過70%的先進材料，使得最大起飛重量比競爭機型減輕46噸。
此機型配備最新的勞斯萊斯（Rolls-Royce）Trent XWB-97發動機，空中巴士宣稱相較於具備類似酬載與航程能力的競爭機型，燃油消耗與碳排放可減少高達40%。
空中巴士表示，截至2026年8月底，A350F已累計獲得來自14家已揭露客戶的11單的訂單，並在大型貨機類別中佔據高達59%的市場佔有率。

en.title: Airbus A350F freighter completes its maiden flight
en.summary: Airbus A350F freighter completes maiden flight; 4h10m flight; 9-month test campaign begins
body: Airbus announced on 29 September 2026 that the A350F freighter (MSN 700), the first of two test aircraft, has completed its first flight. The aircraft, equipped with special flight test instrumentation, flew for 4 hours and 10 minutes reaching an altitude of 25,000 feet.

During the inaugural flight, the crew carried out tests focused on verifying the basic airworthiness, fundamental flying qualities, and ensuring basic systems perform as predicted. This marks the start of an over 9 months flight test campaign, according to Airbus.

Lars Wagner, CEO Commercial Aircraft at Airbus, was quoted saying the maiden flight is a milestone for the A350F and for customers worldwide, describing it as a true game changer for the air cargo market.
The company said the second A350F prototype (MSN 701) is now at an advanced stage of final assembly and will enter the paint shop in the next few weeks.

Airbus said the aircraft has a range capability of up to 8,700 kilometres and a payload up to 111 tonnes, and is made of over 70% advanced materials, resulting in a 46 tonnes lighter maximum take-off weight compared to competitor craft.

The aircraft is powered by the latest Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 engines, which Airbus said could bring a reduction in fuel consumption and carbon emissions of up to 40% Arizona compared to similar aircraft. At the end of August 2026, the A350F system recorded 115 orders from 14 disclosed customers, capturing up to 59 percent market share in the large freighter category.

zh.title: 聯合航空羅馬航班延誤近12小時後取消
zh.summary: 聯合航空羅馬航班取消；旅客受困近12小時獲賠175美元
body: 根據Simple Flying報導，聯合航空（United Airlines）一架波音777（Boeing 777）客機因一連串的延誤，在羅馬（Rome）的機場地面停留近12個小時，最後該航班遭到取消。
報導指出，這些旅客最終獲得175美元的補償。報導提到這次事件是由一連串的挫折所造成，但並未具體說明這些挫折的細節或航班取消後旅客的後續安排。
根據Simple Flying的文章標題，這些旅客被「困」在地面近12小時，而這趟班機最終沒有起飛。報導並未提供原定的起飛時間、目的地機場代碼或其他行程細節。

en.title: United Passengers Stuck Nearly 12 Hours On Rome Flight That Never Took Off Given $175
en.summary: Rome-bound United flight canceled after nearly 12-hour delay; passengers get $175
body: According to Simple Flying, a United Airlines Boeing 777 flight to Rome was held on the ground for nearly 12 hours due to a series of setbacks before the flight was ultimately canceled.
The report states that the passengers received $175 in compensation. It does not provide specific details about the nature of the setbacks or the reasons for the cancellation.

The airline's aircraft, a Boeing 777, was kept on the ground for the extended period before the flight never took off. No further schedule information, airport codes, or alternate arrangements were disclosed in the report. The reported event focuses on the prolonged ground delay and the subsequent cancellation.
